summary: Declare pp:happy-args on the four novel commands that take positional arguments (ddl iter, deputato profilo, commissione dossier, legge cronologia), with real values taken from the run's research examples.
reason: The live dogfood matrix skips happy-path and json-fidelity tests for commands whose positionals it cannot synthesize (`non-id positional "nome" at depth 0`, `command path has fewer segments than placeholders`), and publish validate then fails phase5 with `hollow coverage` for exactly those commands. pp:happy-args is the documented-by-example escape valve used by finra and fred. It does not currently take effect here — those two CLIs annotate endpoint-backed commands, while these four are composite novel commands with no pp:endpoint, so the matrix discards them before reading the annotation (measured: skip reasons byte-identical before and after). The arguments are kept because they are correct and will be honoured once cli-printing-press#4046 is fixed.
validated_outcome: Values verified by hand against the live portal: `ddl iter 18 1153`, `deputato profilo "Abbate Ignazio" --legisl 18`, `commissione dossier SESTA --legisl 18`, `legge cronologia 18 26 --anno 2025` all return populated results. Live dogfood after the change: 113/113 passed, 0 failed.
